ips._comment: triage_assignee_id is the Client Intake agent. Client comments are assigned to it as `todo` so it picks them up, clarifies with the client in their own language, and hands a written spec to the Tech Lead. It is safe to auto-dispatch to BECAUSE its instructions forbid writing code, editing files, deploying, or assigning to a developer. Never point this at a coding agent — that is what opened ips PR #264 from a test comment. Remove the two triage_ keys to fall back to inert backlog/unassigned.
